  150 | |           return { ...state, isFetchingPublic: action.isFetching };

  213 | |     function libraryReducer(state: LibraryState, action: LibraryAction): LibraryState {
  214 | |       switch (action.type) {
  215 | |         case 'SET_SEARCH':
  216 | |           return { ...state, searchQuery: action.query };
  217 | |         case 'SET_DEBOUNCED_SEARCH':
  218 | |           return { ...state, debouncedSearchQuery: action.query };
  219 | |         case 'SET_CATEGORY':
  220 | |           return { ...state, selectedCategoryId: action.id };
  221 | |         case 'SET_SORT':
  222 | |           return { ...state, selectedSort: action.sort };
  223 | |         case 'SET_VIEW_MODE':
  224 | |           return { ...state, viewMode: action.mode };
  225 | |         case 'SET_MODAL':
  226 | |           if (action.name === 'add') return { ...state, isAddModalOpen: action.isOpen };
  227 | |           if (action.name === 'collection')
  228 | |             return { ...state, isAddCollectionModalOpen: action.isOpen };
  229 | |           if (action.name === 'actionSheet') return { ...state, isActionSheetVisible: action.isOpen };
  230 | |           if (action.name === 'picker') return { ...state, isCollectionPickerVisible: action.isOpen };
  231 | |           return state;
  232 | |         case 'SET_SYNCING':
  233 | |           return { ...state, isSyncing: action.isSyncing };
  234 | |         case 'SET_REFRESHING':
  235 | |           return { ...state, refreshing: action.refreshing };
  236 | |         case 'SET_FETCHING_PUBLIC':
  237 | |           return { ...state, isFetchingPublic: action.isFetching };
  238 | |         case 'SET_PUBLIC_COLLECTIONS':
  239 | |           return { ...state, publicCollections: action.collections };
  240 | |         case 'SET_SELECTED_RESOURCE':
  241 | |           return { ...state, selectedResource: action.resource };
  242 | |         case 'MARK_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTED':
  243 | |           return { ...state, fallbackAttempted: true };
  244 | |         default:
  245 | |           return state;
  246 | |       }

  240 | |     const handlePinSubmit = useCallback(async (values: any) => {
  241 | |       if (!user?.id) return;

  244 | |           await accountPin.setPin(user.id, values.pin);
  245 | |           setHasPin(true);
  246 | |           showToast({
  247 | |             message: t('settings.security.pin_created', 'PIN set successfully'),
  248 | |             type: 'success',
  249 | |           });
  250 | |         } else if (pinModalMode === 'remove') {
  251 | |           const correct = await accountPin.verifyPin(user.id, values.pin);
  252 | |           if (correct) {
  253 | |             await accountPin.removePin(user.id);
  254 | |             setHasPin(false);
  255 | |             showToast({

  257 | |               type: 'success',

  262 | |               type: 'error',
  263 | |             });
  264 | |             return;
  265 | |           }
  266 | |         } else if (pinModalMode === 'update') {
  267 | |           const correct = await accountPin.verifyPin(user.id, values.currentPin);
  268 | |           if (correct) {
  269 | |             await accountPin.setPin(user.id, values.nextPin);
